description: Read HTML (pass `html`, or a public `url`) and return a linear approximation of what a screen reader announces, in document order: landmarks, headings with levels, links, buttons, form controls with accessible names and states (required, expanded, checked, disabled and more), images with alt, lists and tables. Accessible names are computed in a simplified way (aria-labelledby, aria-label, label for or wrapping label, alt, title, text content); aria-hidden, hidden and inline display:none are honoured. Problems are flagged inline: no accessible name, generic link text, duplicate landmark with no label, skipped heading level, name from placeholder only, missing alt, table without header cells. Output is capped at the first 250 nodes, with a count of those omitted. This is an approximation of the accessibility tree built from static markup, not a recording of NVDA, JAWS or VoiceOver; it does not run script or apply stylesheets. Returns an object with `report` (the script as text), `nodes` and counts.

html.description: HTML of the page or component to read

url.description: Public page to fetch instead of pasting HTML

name: screen_reader_script
title: Screen reader script
